name: A_LOOKUP_GEOIP_ASN
description: IP → country + ASN enrichment. Input: ip. Fixture-first (small embedded table of demo IPs: SWITCH, Hetzner, OVH, Cloudflare, scanners), then a LIVE keyless lookup via ipwho.is (HTTPS, no API key) for any other IP. Unknown / offline / lookup-failure returns { known: false } rather than throwing.
